description: Single §4.1 llm-selector invocation. The model returns the panel decision as a JSON object in its free-text assistant message (the §6.2 expected_output_schema=null path); the selector component parses it into a SelectorOutput. Selects the full default panel so examples/scripts/walking-skeleton.json can drive the deliberation unchanged. usage is well within examples/configs/llm-selector.yaml's selector_budget.

messages.content: {"selected_agents": ["logician", "visionary", "researcher", "critic", "engineer"], "coordinator_agent": "coordinator", "reasoning": "The protocol-vs-ad-hoc question needs formal structure (logician), reframing (visionary), prior-art evidence (researcher), failure analysis (critic), and implementation cost (engineer) — the full default panel."}
